title: What If You Stood on Callisto?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Callisto, the most cratered moon in the solar system? Look around.
It's one of Jupiter's biggest moons, almost as wide as Mercury, with a surface of ice and rock.
NASA calls it the most heavily cratered of any moon in the solar system. Almost nothing has reshaped it for a very long time.
It's locked to Jupiter, so one day lasts about seventeen Earth days.
It also gets the least radiation of Jupiter's big moons, which is why scientists see it as safer to visit.
And deep below your boots, magnetic data hint at an ocean of liquid water.
